pieces.Text: While maintaining psionic focus, when you successfully perform a disarm combat maneuver, you also deal
damage to the creature disarmed.  If you expend your psionic focus when you make a successful disarm combat maneuver, you can also send the disarmed object into any space of your choosing within
ft.  If a creature is in the selected space and has a hand free, it can grab the disarmed object as an immediate action.
